label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — user-controlled value from Referer header flows through URL decoding and doSomething() to bar, which is used as format string in response.getWriter().format() without HTML encoding, allowing XSS payload injection. Alert 2 (java/tainted-format-string): alert-TP — same data flow confirms user input reaches format string sink. Both alerts share the same exploited path where attacker-controlled Referer header value reaches the response writer via bar variable.

evidence.note: User input obtained from Referer header via getHeaders()
Input decoded via URLDecoder and assigned to param
doSomething processes param and returns bar (modified)
Sink: bar used as format string in writer.format() without HTML encoding
